about: Constructed heading cases for the import title/subtitle heuristic (story-bible-and-import-ux-briefs PRD, Phase 4). 'intended' is what the author meant; 'observed' is what the importer produced when this file was written and is pinned by TestHeadingMisreadFixtures (apps/desktop/internal/importer/heading_misreads_test.go). 'subtitleWentTo' says where the authored subtitle text ended up. 'lineToggleFixes' says whether a per-heading 'second line is subtitle' toggle over the importer's existing lines (PRD I2) is enough to reach 'intended'. 'override', on a case the Phase 5 subtitle override fixes, is the per-heading choice that does it and the chapter's first paragraph afterwards; TestHeadingMisreadOverrides applies it and expects 'intended'. See docs/research/import-heading-misreads.md.
